Among musical-instrument brands that sell at least fifty different products in the catalog, which brand has the highest average list price in dollars? If two brands tie, choose the one whose name sorts first alphabetically.

You have access to a SQLite database that contains three separate product datasets covering different categories: office products, electronics, and musical instruments. You may run up to 15 exploratory SQL queries to examine the schema and data before submitting your final answer. Note: query results are capped at 50 rows — if a query would return more, only the first 50 rows are shown. Use aggregates, LIMIT, or filters when you need to inspect larger tables.

action.content: WITH brands AS (SELECT DISTINCT ref_id, attr_val AS brand FROM product_attributes_g3 WHERE attr_key = 'Brand') SELECT b.brand, COUNT(*) AS products, AVG(i.prc) AS average_price FROM brands b JOIN items_g3 i ON i.ref_id = b.ref_id GROUP BY b.brand HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50 ORDER BY average_price DESC, b.brand ASC LIMIT 1;
